definitions.explanation: The religion and philosophy founded by Siddhartha Gautama (the Buddha). One of the major religions in Japan, influencing culture, art, architecture, and daily customs.

examples.english: There are many Buddhist temples in Japan.

examples.japanese: {仏教|ぶっきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧6⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わった→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: Buddhism was introduced to Japan in the 6th century.

examples.japanese: {仏教|ぶっきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や⟦{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{根|ね}づいて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Buddhist teachings are deeply rooted in Japanese culture and daily customs.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏教|ぶっきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧ (Buddhist teachings)
- {仏教|ぶっきょう}⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧ (Buddhist temple)
- {仏教|ぶっきょう}{徒|と} (Buddhist, Buddhist follower)
- {大乗|だいじょう}{仏教|ぶっきょう} (Mahayana Buddhism)
- {仏教|ぶっきょう}⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (Buddhist art)

CULTURAL NOTE: Most Japanese funerals follow Buddhist rites, and many families have a Buddhist altar (⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧) at home. However, everyday religious practice in Japan often blends Buddhist and Shinto elements.
